get_obs_key_force: use Observations.FORCE.get_obs_key to generate a force observation key for a named wrench sensor
get_obs_key_torque: use Observations.TORQUE.get_obs_key to generate a torque observation key for a named wrench sensor
iterate_observations: iterate over Observations enum members to access all wrench sensor observation types
check_observation_member: check if Observations.FORCE or Observations.TORQUE exists using enum membership tests
format_observation_value: access Observations.FORCE.value or Observations.TORQUE.value to get the raw format string template
